title: Length of the circuit value list
statement: For a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices and a list of gates in topological order, and for any Boolean assignment to its inputs, the list of values obtained by starting with the input values and evaluating the gates in order has length $n$ plus the number of gates.
